description: This file contains a test script that uses shell scripting to test various configurations and behaviors of 'git push' with different 'push.default' settings. It sets up bare repositories, modifies configurations, performs pushes, and validates outcomes to ensure correct functioning of push behaviors under different scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Compares the latest commit on the local revision with the remote revision to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Performs a push with specified 'push.default' setting and checks if the push was successful by verifying the remote commit.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Attempts a push with specified 'push.default' setting expecting it to fail, and confirms no remote changes occurred.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different 'push.default' values within specified workflows (central or triangular), validating success or failure.
